annotations.title: Create, edit or delete a Pinterest product feed

description: Create, edit or delete a Pinterest PRODUCT FEED — the CSV / TSV / XML file of your products Pinterest downloads on a schedule to fill the catalog Shopping ads serve from. action:"create" needs name, location (the feed URL), defaultCountry and defaultLocale (Pinterest refuses a feed without them), optionally format, defaultCurrency, defaultAvailability, catalogId, schedule {time HH:MM, timezone}, credentials. action:"update" changes those on feedId. action:"delete" removes feedId and needs confirm:true — without it nothing changes and the reply names what would go. Read back from Pinterest every time. 0 credits.

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

adAccountId.description: optional — act as this ad account’s owner via Pinterest Business Access (must be shared with this profile)

catalogId.description: catalog to attach the feed to, from list_pinterest_catalogs

credentials.description: only if the feed URL needs a login

password.description: password for the feed URL; only if the URL needs one

username.description: login for the feed URL; only if the URL needs one

defaultAvailability.description: availability for items that omit it: IN_STOCK, OUT_OF_STOCK or PREORDER

defaultCountry.description: two-letter, e.g. US — required on create

defaultCurrency.description: currency for items that omit one, e.g. USD

feedId.description: feed to update or delete, from list_pinterest_catalogs what:feeds

format.description: feed file format: CSV, TSV, XML or INTEGRATION

location.description: the URL Pinterest downloads the feed from

schedule.description: when Pinterest downloads the feed: {time HH:MM, timezone}

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the download time, e.g. America/New_York

name: manage_pinterest_catalog_feed
